newsitem.title: UK: UK shares gain after Dow record, gilts add support.
newsitem.headline: UK shares gain after Dow record, gilts add support.

text.p: British shares nudged higher at the start of trading on Tuesday after Wall Street hit another high and as gilts continued recent gains.

With oil stocks leading the advance on the back of strength in their ADRs in the U.S. yesterday, the FTSE 100 index was up 10.4 points at 3,924.8 by 0843 GMT. Gainers outweighed decliners by some three-to-one.

Persistant fears over the threat of rising British interest rates could continue to hold the market in check, traders said, though some said such fears were overblown and drew comfort from the FTSE 100 holding above the 3,900 level.
